Watts made this hymn from Psalm 10, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble? 2In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise. 3For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD. 4In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God. … 14 more verses PSALM 10 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 10
Arise, O God, lift up thine hand, Attend our humble cry; No enemy shall dare to stand When God ascends on high. STANZA IV
